family.description: This entry, previously known as DUF6936, represents FabMG enoyl-acyl carrier protein reductase (ENR) and related proteins. This enzyme is a FabI-type ENR that employs NADH as a coenzyme and mediates resistance to triclosan. FabMG adopts an alpha/beta structure, with a central parallel beta-sheet elaborated with alpha-helices on both sides. FabMG differs from other related ENRs in sequence and structure. These differences, in particular in the substrate-binding loop and pocket regions in which triclosan binds, could be responsible for the triclosan resistance [[cite:PUB00154385]].
family.name: Enoyl-acyl carrier protein reductase FabMG
